name: web-frontend-react
description: Build React apps: components, hooks, state, effects, performance. Use for React projects (react in package.json), .jsx/.tsx components and hook bugs.
checklist: Keys stable; effects have correct deps
pitfalls: Deriving state that should be computed

name: web-frontend-vue
description: Build Vue 3 apps: Composition API, reactivity, SFCs, Pinia. Use for .vue files and Vue projects.
checklist: No reactivity lost by destructuring reactive()
pitfalls: Losing reactivity by destructuring reactive objects

name: web-frontend-angular
description: Build Angular apps: components, services, DI, RxJS, signals. Use for angular.json projects and .component.ts files.

name: web-frontend-svelte
description: Build Svelte/SvelteKit apps with reactive statements and stores. Use for .svelte files and SvelteKit projects.

name: web-frontend-solid
description: Build SolidJS apps with fine-grained reactivity and signals. Use for Solid projects and .tsx Solid components.
pitfalls: Confusing Solid JSX with React JSX semantics

name: web-frontend-nextjs
description: Build Next.js apps: App Router, server/client components, routing, data fetching, SSR/SSG. Use for next.config.js projects.
checklist: Server vs client component boundary correct
No client-only APIs in server components

name: web-frontend-nuxt
description: Build Nuxt 3 apps: pages, composables, server routes, SSR. Use for nuxt.config.ts projects.
pitfalls: State shared across requests on the server

name: web-frontend-astro
description: Build Astro sites with islands architecture and content collections. Use for astro.config.mjs projects and .astro files.
checklist: Ship minimal JS (islands only where needed)
pitfalls: Hydrating everything and losing the perf win

name: web-frontend-remix
description: Build Remix apps: loaders, actions, nested routes, progressive enhancement. Use for Remix projects.
pitfalls: Fetching in components instead of loaders

name: web-frontend-qwik
description: Build Qwik apps with resumability and lazy execution. Use for Qwik projects. Detect the toolchain first.

name: web-accessibility
description: Make web UI accessible to WCAG 2.2 AA: semantics, keyboard, focus, contrast, ARIA, screen readers. Use when building or auditing UI.
pitfalls: ARIA misused where semantic HTML suffices
Focus traps and lost focus on route change

name: web-tailwind
description: Style with Tailwind CSS utility classes and design tokens. Use for tailwind.config projects and utility-class styling.
checklist: Design tokens in config, not scattered magic values
pitfalls: Unbounded class soup instead of components
Missing content globs producing empty CSS

name: web-vite
description: Configure and debug Vite builds, dev server, plugins and env handling. Use for vite.config projects.
checklist: Env vars prefixed (VITE_) for client exposure
pitfalls: Slow HMR from misconfigured deps optimization

name: web-webpack
description: Configure and debug webpack: loaders, plugins, code splitting, tree shaking. Use for webpack.config.js projects.
checklist: Source maps configured for the environment
Tree shaking not defeated by side effects
pitfalls: sideEffects flag missing, breaking tree shaking

name: web-state-management
description: Choose and apply frontend state management (local, context, Redux, Zustand, Pinia, signals) appropriately. Use when state grows tangled.
checklist: Server state (queries) separated from UI state
Global store only for truly shared state
pitfalls: Putting server cache state in global stores by hand

name: web-forms-validation
description: Build accessible forms with client and server validation and good error UX. Use when implementing forms and input validation.
checklist: Validate on the server too, never client-only

name: web-performance
description: Optimize web performance: Core Web Vitals, bundle size, lazy loading, caching, rendering. Use when pages are slow or fail CWV.

name: web-pwa
description: Add PWA features: service workers, offline caching, manifest, installability. Use when making a web app installable/offline.
checklist: Cache strategy matches content freshness needs
pitfalls: Caching too aggressively and serving stale assets

name: web-seo
description: Optimize technical SEO: metadata, structured data, sitemaps, canonical, crawlability, performance. Use for public sites.
pitfalls: Blocking crawlers in robots.txt by accident

name: web-component-testing
description: Test UI components by behavior with Testing Library / Playwright component tests. Use when adding frontend tests.
checklist: Query by role/text, not implementation details
pitfalls: Testing internal state instead of behavior

name: backend-node
description: Build Node.js backends: async IO, streams, process/cluster, env config. Use for Node server projects.
checklist: Config from env, validated at boot
pitfalls: Blocking the event loop with sync CPU work
Unhandled promise rejections crashing the process

name: backend-express
description: Build Express APIs: routing, middleware, error handling, validation. Use for Express projects.
pitfalls: Missing async error propagation to error middleware

name: backend-nestjs
description: Build NestJS apps: modules, providers, DI, guards, pipes. Use for NestJS projects.
checklist: Guards for auth; interceptors for cross-cutting

name: backend-fastapi
description: Build FastAPI services: async endpoints, Pydantic models, dependency injection, OpenAPI. Use for FastAPI projects.
pitfalls: Blocking sync calls in async endpoints
Returning ORM models instead of schemas

name: backend-django
description: Build Django apps: ORM, migrations, views, DRF, admin, security. Use for manage.py projects.
checklist: DEBUG off and security settings for prod
pitfalls: N+1 queries from lazy ORM access

name: backend-flask
description: Build Flask apps: blueprints, extensions, request handling, config. Use for Flask projects.
checklist: App factory pattern; config per environment

name: backend-spring
description: Build Spring Boot services: controllers, services, JPA, security, config. Use for Spring Boot projects.

name: backend-dotnet
description: Build ASP.NET Core services: minimal APIs/controllers, DI, EF Core, middleware. Use for .NET web projects.
checklist: EF queries not tracking when read-only
pitfalls: EF Core N+1 and cartesian explosions

name: backend-laravel
description: Build Laravel apps: Eloquent, migrations, routing, middleware, queues. Use for artisan projects.
checklist: Eloquent eager loading to avoid N+1

name: backend-rails
description: Build Ruby on Rails apps: ActiveRecord, migrations, controllers, jobs. Use for Rails projects.
pitfalls: Callbacks with side effects hard to test

name: backend-phoenix
description: Build Phoenix (Elixir) web apps and LiveView. Use for Phoenix projects.
pitfalls: Heavy work in LiveView process blocking UI

name: backend-go-http
description: Build Go HTTP services with net/http or chi/gin: handlers, middleware, context. Use for Go web services.

name: backend-graphql
description: Design and build GraphQL APIs: schema, resolvers, N+1 via dataloader, auth. Use for GraphQL servers/schemas.

name: backend-rest-api
description: Design RESTful APIs: resources, status codes, versioning, pagination, idempotency, errors. Use when designing/reviewing HTTP APIs.

name: backend-grpc
description: Build gRPC services with protobuf: service definitions, streaming, deadlines, errors. Use for .proto files and gRPC services.

name: backend-websockets
description: Build realtime features with WebSockets/SSE: connection lifecycle, backpressure, auth, scaling. Use for realtime servers.
checklist: Auth on connect and per-message where needed

name: backend-auth
description: Implement authentication/authorization: sessions vs JWT, OAuth/OIDC, password hashing, RBAC. Use for login/auth features.
checklist: Authorization checked on every protected action

name: backend-caching
description: Add caching (in-memory, Redis, HTTP) with correct invalidation and TTLs. Use when reducing latency/load.

name: backend-queues
description: Use message queues/background jobs (Redis, RabbitMQ, SQS, Celery, BullMQ): idempotency, retries, DLQ. Use for async processing.

name: backend-rate-limiting
description: Protect APIs with rate limiting and throttling (token bucket, sliding window). Use to prevent abuse/overload.
pitfalls: Rate limiting after expensive work, not before
